title: The Canoe Race
offer: Race us! Whoever touches the jetties of Ålberga, Dimmberga and Svanetorp first and comes back here wins. Can you do it before the day ends?

steps.say: Ålberga: touched! The canoe is right behind you!
Dimmberga! Row, row, they are close!
You won! But only by a nose. Next time we win! Here, the prize: a honey cake each, and silver.

fact: Vikings loved contests: rowing, swimming, wrestling and running.
